description: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores of three models—LLaMA-3-8B-it, Ours (Iterative RLHF), and GSM-8k—across seven datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis represents the categories of datasets and metrics, labeled as GSM-8k, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC-AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis represents the score, labeled as “Score (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Three bars are present for each dataset/metric category, representing the performance of each model; the bars for LLaMA-3-8B-it, Ours (Iterative RLHF), and GSM-8k are colored steelblue, darkorange, and lightgray, respectively. For GSM-8k, the LLaMA-3-8B-it bar reaches approximately 73, Ours (Iterative RLHF) reaches approximately 76, and GSM-8k reaches approximately 68. The bars are not visually emphasized, and no annotations are present.
